protocol.hypothesis: A19 can overlook a useful ground-approach Fire Wall when the native one-wall planner prioritizes a flyer or remaining ranged/damage-spell output. Compare one restricted-ground geometry while preserving every normal choice.
protocol.policy: Own Nightmare root decisions only, with an existing legal Fire Wall in the ordinary catalog. Reuse the native centroid/perpendicular/three-fraction geometry for visible living ground units without usable ranged or damaging-spell output. Require at least one excluded enemy and one eligible ground enemy. No full-grid fallback, no gaps through creatures, no duplicate lit-cell set already in the ordinary catalog. Append at most one candidate after native shortlisting. Preserve all ordinary alternatives, native rollout controller, scoring/arbitration, neural models/margins and cast opportunity cost. Extra ordinary H64/complementary-R2 comparison; no force-cast or immediate-damage bonus.
protocol.population: Fresh legal drafts with candidate choosing Nightmare whenever it is currently visible in a creature-pick offer; otherwise adopted V3/contextual decisions. Ordinary policy state is not consumed on a forced preference. Opponent remains adopted default. Select first2 successful Nightmare rosters per pick order per map/own-doctrine/opponent-doctrine stratum from fixed96-entry pools. All selection roster-only, before battles. Native ranked amounts, funded setup, support/splits and placement; no synthetic roster replacement.
protocol.comparison: Both physical seats x2 independent combat futures x off/observe/on:1296 executions.18 fixed map/own-doctrine/seat cold cases x3:54. Total1350.
protocol.score: Win1/draw0.5/loss0; keep all native outcomes. Average4 paired differences/family,108 equal families. Whole-family percentile bootstrap20000 PythonRandom73117719. Report all map/own-doctrine/opponent-doctrine means.
developmentGates: At least10 changed trajectories across at least2 maps
At least3 selected new walls across at least2 maps
Gain at least+0.5 score percentage points
protocol.advancement: Only a pass permits separately registered independent qualification/confirmation and serial serving cost within+10%. No automatic default adoption.
limitations: Ground-only classification is a movement hypothesis, not exact route/reach prediction.
Wall burns both sides; whole-game search still decides whether casting beats attacking, Empower or moving.
Legal Nightmare-preference armies do not estimate default Nightmare draft frequency or unconditional global strength.

seedDerivation.preimage: first4 SHA256 bytes of namespace:counter, little endian uint32
seedDerivation.channels: For every scanned preimage n, all(n+i)>>>0 and permuteRankedDraftSeed(n+i) for i=0..31; reserve rejected and unused scans too.

development.scope: Conditional on legal Nightmare-preference drafts; not representative default draft frequency or unconditional global strength.

geometryAudit.scope: Independent Python reconstruction from captured public geometry. All 432 baseline-observer and 432 treatment battles; no outcomes used and no policy adjustment.

wallUseAudit.scope: Descriptive actual-event metrics across all complete pairs and all changed first decisions. Wall burns are classified relative to the candidate team; ownWallOnly metrics exclude any game with another-team wall source. Damage/tempo metrics do not replace registered match-score gates or isolate later-policy/chance effects.

mechanicsDiagnostic.scope: Deterministic mechanics fixture only; no complete-game or strength outcome collected.

neuralObservationDiagnostic.scope: Deterministic observation/model diagnostic; no training or battle strength evidence.
neuralObservationDiagnostic.limitation: Unchanged candidate metadata was held fixed to isolate missing state channels. Search still simulates walls, and other candidate features may change indirectly after fire affects health or available actions. This does not establish a complete-agent blind spot or a measured policy gain.

outcomeTraceAudit.scope: All seven outcome-changing pairs, selected only for descriptive diagnosis after the registered result. Complete-game wall burns and the first five turns are observations, not isolated causal estimates. No retuning or additional strength games.

interpretation.scope: Conditional on legal Nightmare-preference drafts; not representative default draft frequency or unconditional global strength.
interpretation.development: The original registered gates determine the disposition; secondary damage or subgroup results do not override them.
interpretation.neuralGap: Wall orientation and existing fire cells/lifetime/power are absent from the frozen A19 observation. Identical tensor inputs and model outputs were independently demonstrated with different authoritative crossing damage. Search still simulates fire.
interpretation.futureBoundary: A new route-aware or observation/training hypothesis needs a distinct registration, fresh outcome banks, independent qualification/confirmation and serial serving-cost validation. Do not reinterpret the opened pilot as an untouched holdout.
interpretation.diagnosticCorrection: The separate shot-mechanics fixture initially used a wrong numeric attack type; the corrected fixture uses symbolic PBTypes.AttackVals.RANGE. Both source versions and the failed diagnostic log are preserved. No registered battle was retried or modified.
